{{Quote|It's all just smoke and mirrors&hellip;|Line from the love song|<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>}}
A '''love song''' that was popular in [[41 ABY]] was sung by a [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] singer at the [[Indigo Tower]], an upmarket restaurant on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The lyrics indicated the futility and delusive nature of love.<ref name="Omen" />

The Pa'lowick musician performed the song in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] on the night [[Jagged Fel]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] entered the restaurant closely followed by [[Javis Tyrr]], a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] reporter, and escaped out a back entrance using [[Karn Valanti]] and [[Lina Zev]], respectively, as their doubles to fool him. Javis Tyrr thought the line ''smoke and mirrors'' rather ironic, as he was duped in the same fashion in a wild [[caranak]] chase.<ref name="Omen" />

==Lyrics==
''Its all just a dream, isn't it?<br />This thing we call love&hellip;<br />A marvelous scheme, isn't it?<br />This thing we call love&hellip;''<ref name="Omen" />

&hellip;

''It's just an illusion,<br />A trick of the heart,<br />A pleasant delusion<br />When two are apart&mdash;''<ref name="Omen" />

&hellip;

''It's all just smoke and mirrors, darling;<br />A pretty lie and nothing more.''<ref name="Omen" />
